content.title: Your first PDF in five minutes
content.lede: Install the two CLIs with go install, or build them from a checkout. No cgo or browser process. Then turn a local HTML file into a PDF with a single opt-in flag.

content.heading: Requirements
items: Go 1.26 or newer (go.mod declares go 1.26 and pins toolchain go1.26.4). The first build may download the two allowlisted direct modules and their transitive Go module graph; later builds can run offline with the cache populated.
No cgo and no native libraries. Build with CGO_ENABLED=0 to get statically linked ELF/Mach-O binaries with no runtime library requirements.
Native conversion uses no browser process, WebKit, or third-party HTML-to-PDF service. The optional browser route uses the same pipeline through WebAssembly.

The two allowlisted direct pure-Go modules are github.com/go-text/typesetting for OpenType shaping and github.com/tdewolff/canvas for SVG rasterization; there is no browser or native converter dependency.

content.heading: Install with Go
content.code:
go install github.com/chinmay-sawant/gowkhtmltopdf/cmd/gowkhtmltopdf@v0.2.5
go install github.com/chinmay-sawant/gowkhtmltopdf/cmd/gowkhtmltoimage@v0.2.5
gowkhtmltopdf --version   # Name: gowkhtmltopdf / Version: 0.2.5

content.heading: Build
content.code:
# recommended: static binaries, version stamped from VERSION
make build
# writes bin/gowkhtmltopdf and bin/gowkhtmltoimage

# equivalent, explicit:
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags "-X github.com/chinmay-sawant/gowkhtmltopdf/internal/cli.Version=$(cat VERSION)" \
  -o bin/gowkhtmltopdf ./cmd/gowkhtmltopdf
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags "-X github.com/chinmay-sawant/gowkhtmltopdf/internal/cli.Version=$(cat VERSION)" \
  -o bin/gowkhtmltoimage ./cmd/gowkhtmltoimage

./bin/gowkhtmltopdf --version   # Name: gowkhtmltopdf / Version: 0.2.5
# VERSION is the project release. LibraryVersion (0.12.7-dev) is the
# wkhtmltopdf settings-surface id, not the release number.

content.title: Prebuilt binaries
content.body: Tagged releases publish static gowkhtmltopdf and gowkhtmltoimage builds for Linux, Windows, and macOS (amd64 and arm64) plus SHA256SUMS. Download from the GitHub Releases page. Ordinary CI on pull requests does not upload platform archives.

content.heading: Opt-in PDF version or profile
content.code:
# Default is unclaimed PDF 1.4. --pdf-version is not a PDF/A or PDF/UA claim.
./bin/gowkhtmltopdf --pdf-version 1.7 --allow-local-files -o /tmp/invoice-1.7.pdf \
  testdata/golden/fixture-01-simple-invoice.html
./bin/gowkhtmltopdf --pdf-version 2.0 --allow-local-files -o /tmp/invoice-2.0.pdf \
  testdata/golden/fixture-01-simple-invoice.html

# Dual PDF/A-3a + PDF/UA-1 (implies PDF 1.7)
./bin/gowkhtmltopdf --pdf-profile a3a-ua1 --allow-local-files -o /tmp/invoice-a3a-ua1.pdf \
  testdata/golden/fixture-01-simple-invoice.html

# Dual PDF/A-4 + PDF/UA-2 (implies PDF 2.0)
./bin/gowkhtmltopdf --pdf-profile a4-ua2 --allow-local-files -o /tmp/invoice-a4-ua2.pdf \
  testdata/golden/fixture-01-simple-invoice.html

content.title: Local files are blocked by default
content.body: Every local file read goes through a security ACL, so you must opt in with --allow-local-files on the CLI (or Document.AllowLocalFiles in the library API). Remote URLs are fetched with timeouts, redirect limits, and size caps, but never hand untrusted user URLs straight to the renderer: that is the classic SSRF pattern here and in upstream wkhtmltopdf.

sections.heading: Open the result
sections.body: Open /tmp/invoice.pdf in any PDF viewer. Committed sample outputs live in output/ and are regenerated with make samples.

sections.heading: PDF bytes to stdout
sections.body: Pass - as the output path to write the raw PDF bytes to stdout instead of a file. Pair it with --quiet so progress messages do not pollute the stream.
bullets: The clean byte stream pipes directly into an HTTP response or a downstream tool.

sections.heading: Repeatable output
sections.body: The same HTML, settings, and metadata time produce a repeatable PDF structure. Default CLI conversions use the wall clock for PDF dates and [date]/[time] placeholders, so bytes are not hash-stable unless you inject Now on the typed library API.

content.heading: Makefile targets
rows: test
Full suite with capped concurrency: go test -p 2 -parallel 2 ./...; override the caps with TEST_P / TEST_PARALLEL and pass extra flags with GO_TEST_FLAGS
test-quick / test-unit
test-quick adds -short (skips long perf-budget tests); test-unit skips internal/convert; both keep the -p 2 -parallel 2 caps
test-serial / test-race
test-serial runs -p 1 -parallel 1 for very low RAM; test-race runs -race -count=1 on internal/convert, layout, pdf, imageout, and load
lint
golangci-lint (pinned v1.64.8), then size-check, then frontend npm run lint
size-check / lint-frontend
size-check enforces the file-size soft limit (scripts/check-file-size.sh); lint-frontend runs ESLint plus the src/data content and config checks
build
Builds both static binaries (gowkhtmltopdf, gowkhtmltoimage) into bin/, version stamped from VERSION
wasm / wasm-test
wasm builds the browser artifact into frontend/public/wasm/ (GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm); wasm-test runs the adapter contract, frontend lint/build/tests, and the Chrome live-demo harness
golden
Walks every testdata/golden/*.html fixture and asserts PDF structure, embedded fonts, page envelopes, and feature flags
golden-update GOLDEN_FIXTURE=... GOLDEN_APPROVE=1
Generates one explicitly approved fixture PDF under ignored testdata/golden/out/; never rewrites fixture sources
samples / samples-python / screenshots

samples rewrites output/ (fixture PDFs/PNGs, showcase TOC/header/footer/outline, 1.7/2.0 and profile smokes, soft-fail wiki fetch); samples-python writes output/python/ and needs CGO_ENABLED=1; screenshots regenerates the frontend showcase images
weasyprint
Regenerates the WeasyPrint comparison PDFs under output/weasyprint/ (requires the weasyprint CLI)
bench / bench-engine / bench-lib
bench runs the external CLI comparisons via scripts/bench-external.sh; bench-engine is the internal engine matrix (bench-inprocess is its alias); bench-lib times the public Document/ImageDocument API
bench-cli-compare
Process-level comparison against installed wkhtmltopdf (make build first)
c-shared / bindings-clean
c-shared builds dist/libgowkhtmltopdf.so plus the generated header with CGO_ENABLED=1; bindings-clean removes dist/
python-binding-test / python-benchmarks / python-api
Builds the shared library and runs the Python unittest suite, the in-process Python benchmark matrix, or the Python sample generators
claim-scan / check-versions
claim-scan fails on forbidden over-claim phrases; check-versions gates VERSION against bindings/python
fmt / clean
gofmt -w .; clean removes testdata/golden/out and dist
